# LihuaDoku True 3D Tabby Mascot

This is an original realtime asset generated inside this project. It does not
contain an external model, scan, stock mesh, Spine skeleton, video, or frame
sequence.

Rebuild with the pinned Blender 4.5.3 toolchain from the repository root:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/3d/install-blender.ps1
.\.tools\blender-4.5.3\blender.exe --background --python tools/3d/build-tabby-mascot.py -- --output assets/resources/models/tabby-mascot --source-blend output/visual/tabby-mascot/tabby-mascot-source.blend
node tools/3d/validate-tabby-mascot.mjs assets/resources/models/tabby-mascot/tabby-mascot.gltf
```

The exported asset is intended for the Home and completed Result presentation
surfaces. Runtime quality adaptation may reduce render-target resolution,
shadow quality, and secondary-action frequency, but must remain realtime 3D.
